The '''bio-cocoon''' was manufactured by [[Dendratis Biological Exports, Incorporated]]. It was a 1.5 square meter of durable fiber coated with a layer of dormant microorganisms. The microorganisms fed off [[Bioelectricity/Legends|bio-electricity]]. When a creature stood on the fiber, a remote control would trigger other organisms that activated the microorganisms. They fed off the target's bio-electrictity, swarming over the creature and creating a porous biological cocoon.<ref name="GFT" />
